description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter UI screen called PatientsScreen, which displays a list of patients retrieved from a PatientProvider. It includes UI widgets for loading, error handling, refreshing, and listing patients, as well as a stub for creating new patients.

classes.name: PatientsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of patients using PatientProvider.

classes.name: _PatientsScreenState
classes.description: State class for PatientsScreen, manages fetching and displaying patient data.

classes.name: _PatientTile
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that represents an individual patient's display tile.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers fetching of patient data after the first frame.

methods.name: _refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the patient list by calling fetchAll on PatientProvider.

methods.name: _createStub
methods.description: Shows a snack bar indicating patient creation is coming soon.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the PatientsScreen, handling loading, error, empty, and populated states.

methods.name: _PatientTile.build
methods.description: Builds the UI for an individual patient tile showing name, email, and age.
